notes.title: Happy Halloween! A New Hat-Tabulous Update has been posted!!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/f05bb7aa877485cb9c9d4c96735a85433cdbd9d9.png

To celebrate that we're on Sale we decided to add a ton of new hats to the game. There are now over 1100 hats to unlock, in addition to some other changes and a new slice hunt game mode modifier!


    Added a ton of new hats for your slothy heads and that undeniable fun of unlocking them!
    New Game Mode Option, turn on/off Slice Denied to disallow scoring of your own team's slices for a Slice Hunt variation of classic game mode, Kill Confirmed!
    Fix to public lobbys to not have private controls in some instances
    Made it so that going into match settings does not reset game mode
    Various other bug fixes


http://store.steampowered.com/app/459350/Battlesloths_2025_The_Great_Pizza_Wars/


Get the game now while it's still on sale! Oh... and remember... Stay Slothy!

notes.title: Big Update! New Levels! Mayan Mutant Sewers of Slouth America! Moar Hats!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/6b3edacea274fb1939843c0d1b549d90af625b3d.gif

It's here! The Sloths are venturing deep down into the dank sewers of Central Slouth America... There are three new levels within the new location and tons of new hats to fight over and unlock! More fun to come. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/459350/Battlesloths_2025_The_Great_Pizza_Wars/

Complete breakdown of the update below!

Are you ready for the Changelist??


     3 new levels in a brand new biome, Mayan Sewers!
     Adding a bunch of new hats to unlock! Including the Acheivement Hunter Mr. Diddles! He has two watches and he's ashamed of being a diddler, but he's also a champion at it.
     The Mutant Sewers feature a brand new hazard, rushing water that can push and destroy sloths and slices.
     Fixes timed game modes not finishing.
     Sprucing up the Hat Unlock animation with a few SFX to randomize between
     Bots can only equip normal hats now. No more Golden Hats for you dirty theiving AI bots! 


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26177583/3e39e38f89ca2d937fdc0a0798738fa472497914.gif
